chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Fazalat ibn Ayoub, from Muawiya ibn Ammar who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'Will you specialise me with a supplication?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.

He (peace be upon him) said: 'Say: O One, O Glorified, O Unique, O Eternal, O He who did not beget and was not begotten, and there was none comparable to Him. O Mighty, O Generous, O Affectionate, O Bestower, O Hearer of supplications, O Most Generous of those asked, and O Best of those who give. O Allah, O Allah, O Allah.' I said, 'And Nuh (Noah) certainly called upon Us, so excellent are the Responders.'

Then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to say: 'Yes, excellent is the Responder, excellent is the One supplicated to, and excellent is the One asked from'.

'I ask You by the Light of Your Face, and I ask You by Your Might, and Your Power, and Your Compulsion, and I ask You by Your Kingdom, and Your Fortified Shield, and by Your Grip, and all Your Pillars, and by the right of Muhammad, and by the right of the Successors after Muhammad, that You should send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, and that You should do such and such with me.'

key_terms.لَمْ يَلِدْ وَ لَمْ يُولَدْ: He did not beget and was not begotten

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication for fulfilling needs according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* presents a concise yet profound supplication (*du'a*) emphasizing Allah's absolute uniqueness (*Tawhid*) through the recitation of key divine names, linking the Prophet's tradition with Imam al-Sadiq's teaching. It uniquely incorporates the Quranic verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas (112:3) to affirm God's indivisibility, while concluding with a petition grounded in the intercessory rights (*Haqq*) of the Prophet and the Imams, reflecting the Shia emphasis on their spiritual authority. The reference to Prophet Nuh highlights the efficacy of calling upon Allah as the ultimate Respondent, reinforcing the theme of divine accessibility in times of need.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Can youasws specialise me with a supplication?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’. Heasws said: ‘Say, ‘O the One, O Glorified, O the First, O the Last, O the One Who does not beget and is not begotten and there does not happen anyone to be a match for Himazwj! O the Mighty, O the Benevolent, O the Affectionate, O the Benefactor, O the Hearer of the supplications, O the most Generous of the asked ones, and O the Best of the ones who give. O Allahazwj! O Allahazwj!’. I said, ‘[37:75] And Nuh did call upon Us, so the most excellent Responders are We’. Then Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww was saying: ‘Yes, Youazwj are the Best of the Responders, and the best of the ones supplicated to, and best of the ones asked from’. (Say), ‘I ask Youazwj by the Light of Yourazwj Face, and I ask Youazwj by Yourazwj Might, and Yourazwj Power, and Yourazwj Compulsion, and I ask Youazwj by Yourazwj Kingdom, and Yourazwj Fortified Shield, and by Yourazwj Grip, and Yourazwj Elements, all of them, and by the right of Muhammadsaww, and by the right of the successorsas after Muhammadsaww, that Youazwj should Send Salawāt upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww, and that Youazwj should Do such and such with me’’.
en.sarwar: 19. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Once I said to abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) ‘Will you instruct me with a special supplication?’ The Imam said, ‘Yes, I will do so,

say, “O the One, the Glorious, the Only, O self-sufficient. Who has not given birth to anyone and is not born from anyone and Who has no partner, O Majestic, O Magnanimous, O Compassionate, O Obliging, O Hearer of supplications, O the Most Generous of those who are asked for help, O the Best of those who give, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, You have said, ‘Noah pleaded before Us for help and We are the best to answer.’ “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) then said, ‘The Messenger of Allah would say, “Yes, indeed. You are the best Who answers, the best to be called for help, and the best to plead with,

I plead before You through the light of Your face, through Your majesty, Your power, Your might, I plead before You through Your kingdom, through Your formidable coats of arm and Your community, the members of Your community all of them, through Muhammad (a.s.) and the successors after Muhammad to grant al-Salat (favors) upon Muhammad and his family and provide me help in such and such matters.” (One should mention one’s wishes).”’
